modules.title: Introduction to Al'adu da Kulture (Culture and Customs)
modules.html:
Hausa marriage, naming ceremonies and festivals. This section covers introduction to al'adu da kulture (culture and customs).

Key points

  • Study the meaning, main features and examples of al'adu da kulture (culture and customs).
  • Be able to explain al'adu da kulture (culture and customs) in your own words and give examples.
  • Practise the 50-question quiz for this topic until you score well without notes.

Worked examples

Q: Kalmar 'Yarinya' tana nuna jinsi na _____.
A: Mace — 'Yarinya' means 'girl', which falls under the feminine (mace) gender category.

Q: A cikin 'Tatsuniya', wanene ya fi kowa wayo (cleverness)?
A: Gizo — In Hausa folklore (tatsuniya), Gizo (the spider) is the archetypal trickster known for his cunning.

examples.q: A cikin 'Tatsuniya', wanene ya fi kowa wayo (cleverness)?

quiz.q: Kalmar 'Yarinya' tana nuna jinsi na _____.
quiz.solution: 'Yarinya' means 'girl', which falls under the feminine (mace) gender category.

quiz.q: A cikin 'Tatsuniya', wanene ya fi kowa wayo (cleverness)?
quiz.solution: In Hausa folklore (tatsuniya), Gizo (the spider) is the archetypal trickster known for his cunning.

quiz.q: A cikin lissafi, 'Dari biyar' nawa ne?
quiz.solution: 'Dari' means hundred and 'Biyar' means five, totaling 500.

quiz.q: Menene ma'anar 'Kayan daki' a wurin biki?
quiz.solution: In Hausa wedding culture, 'Kayan daki' refers to the household furniture and utilities provided for the bride's new home.

quiz.q: Wane littafi ne Bello Kagara ya rubuta?
quiz.solution: Bello Kagara is the author of the epic novel 'Gandoki'.

quiz.q: Wane asali ne Hausawa suke da shi na farko?
quiz.solution: The 'Hausa Bakwai' represents the seven original Hausa city-states.

quiz.q: Wace rana ce 'Friday' a Hausa?
quiz.solution: Friday is called 'Jumma'a', the holy day for Muslims.

quiz.q: Menene 'Sana'o'i'?
quiz.solution: Sana'o'i refers to the various ways people earn a living (Trades/Crafts).

quiz.q: Wanne ne 'jinsin mace' (feminine) na 'Yaro'?
quiz.solution: The feminine equivalent of 'Yaro' (boy) is 'Yarinya' (girl).

quiz.q: Menene 'Jinsin miji' (masculine) na 'Uwa'?
quiz.solution: The masculine equivalent of 'Uwa' (mother) is 'Uba' (father).

quiz.q: Wanne ne babban birnin jihar Kaduna?
quiz.solution: The capital city of Kaduna State is Kaduna.
